instructions: The night before, if your phyllo is frozen: transfer the package to the fridge to thaw.
Peel the zucchini and grate it on the large holes of a box grater. Transfer it to a colander, toss with 1 tsp salt and leave it in the sink for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oven to 350°F/180°C. Melt the butter and set it aside. Brush an 8-inch square baking dish with a little of the butter.
Finely chop the onion. Warm 1 tbsp olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft. Take the pan off the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Squeeze the grated zucchini dry in handfuls, then wrap it in a clean towel and squeeze again. Transfer it to a large bowl.
Add the onion, egg, yogurt, crumbled feta, breadcrumbs, parsley, mint and the pepper to the zucchini. Stir until evenly mixed.
Lay 1 sheet of phyllo in the dish, letting the edges hang over, and brush it with butter. Repeat with 2 more sheets.
Spoon in the filling and spread it level. Fold the overhanging phyllo over the filling.
Lay 1 sheet over the top and brush it with butter. Repeat with 2 more sheets, then tuck the edges down inside the dish.
Brush the top with the rest of the butter. With a sharp knife, score the top into 8 pieces, cutting about 1/4 inch deep.
Bake on the middle rack for 45 minutes, until deep golden. Let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
Serve warm or at room temperature. For lunches, let it cool completely and wrap it well. It keeps for 3 days in the fridge. Reheat slices in a 350°F oven for 15 minutes.
advance_prep_notes: thaw frozen phyllo in the fridge the night before
method_notes: My Greek Dish (the lead, 4.9 from 665 ratings) and Dimitra's Dishes agree on grated zucchini salted and squeezed dry, feta, egg, fresh mint and a crisp phyllo case. They differ on dairy and fat: the lead adds strained yogurt and uses olive oil or butter on shop-bought phyllo, Dimitra's adds a second cheese and brushes with a lot of butter. This follows the lead, scaled from 1 kg zucchini to 500 g, using the lead's commercial phyllo shortcut with butter, and skipping its sesame seeds.
